headline: CVS Health Plans to Separate Pharmacy Operations by 2028
summary: CVS Health announced plans to split off its pharmacy business into a new company by 2028. The company will retain its insurance and pharmacy benefit operations.
why: CVS Health is a major healthcare conglomerate combining retail pharmacy, pharmacy benefit management, and health insurance. Structural changes of this magnitude redefine operations and capital allocation in the healthcare sector.
